skill.summary: 运用技能提升 OneDay 应用的视觉设计

latestVersion.changelog:
Major overhaul: The skill has been completely redefined from a news summary tool to a comprehensive internal design director system for visual output.

- Replaced previous skill for summarizing news with a new skill focused on elevating visual design for the OneDay app.
- Added a detailed, step-by-step system describing design review, optimization techniques, visual standards, and execution processes for all visual outputs.
- Included best-practice design checklists, technical catalogs, design benchmarks, and inspiration sources.
- Emphasized internal-only design critique, ensuring users only see the polished final output.
- Outlined clear design philosophy and adaptation guidelines for diverse content needs.
